bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
sha=960501dff324a58dd64fd9f3b20d57531bcff752
n=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
git fetch --no-tags origin "$sha" >/dev/null 2>&1
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$sha" || exit 61
wt="$root/.worktrees/stk-nav-replay-960501d"
if test -e "$wt";then test "$(git -C "$wt" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$sha" || exit 62;else mkdir -p "$root/.worktrees";git worktree add --detach "$wt" "$sha" >/dev/null 2>&1;fi
base=create-videobot:menu-home-e9cc45d
img=create-videobot:menu-replay-960501d
docker image inspect "$base" >/dev/null || exit 63
docker build --network none --pull=false -t "$img" -f - "$wt" >/dev/null <<'DOCKERFILE'
FROM create-videobot:menu-home-e9cc45d
COPY --chown=node:node src/telegram/creatorWebhookAdmission.mjs /opt/videobot/src/telegram/creatorWebhookAdmission.mjs
COPY --chown=node:node src/sales/pgWebhookUpdates.mjs /opt/videobot/src/sales/pgWebhookUpdates.mjs
DOCKERFILE
docker run --rm --network none --pull never --entrypoint node "$img" --check /opt/videobot/src/telegram/creatorWebhookAdmission.mjs >/dev/null || exit 64
docker run --rm --network none --pull never --entrypoint node "$img" --check /opt/videobot/src/sales/pgWebhookUpdates.mjs >/dev/null || exit 65
token="$(docker inspect -f '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/run/secrets/videobot_telegram_token"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}' "$n")"
pass="$(docker inspect -f '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/run/secrets/videobot_db_password"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}' "$n")"
test -f "$token" && test -f "$pass" || exit 66
pg=deploy-postgres-1
user="$(docker exec "$pg" sh -c 'printf %s "$POSTGRES_USER"')"
pin="$HOME/.local/state/create-videobot/sticker-pin"
test -f "$pin/group2373696859_thread4640.json" || exit 67
export VIDEOBOT_TELEGRAM_TOKEN_SOURCE="$token" VIDEOBOT_DB_PASSWORD_SOURCE="$pass" VIDEOBOT_STICKER_PIN_STATE_SOURCE="$pin" GSERVER_POSTGRES_USER="$user" GSERVER_POSTGRES_NETWORK=deploy_default
compose="$HOME/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/native-sticker-c8c50d420c0b9b5d447a1fc87ef3d9e1ec7aceed/deploy/compose.videobot.poll.yaml"
docker compose -p gace-createvdobot -f "$compose" config --quiet || exit 68
old="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$n")"
docker image tag "$old" create-videobot:before-nav-replay
docker image tag "$img" create-videobot:local-poll
docker compose -p gace-createvdobot -f "$compose" up -d --no-build --force-recreate videobot-poll >/dev/null || exit 69
sleep 14
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$n")" = true || exit 70
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$n")" = "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$img")" || exit 71
count="$(docker inspect -f '{{.RestartCount}}' "$n")"
sleep 9
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$n")" = true || exit 72
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.RestartCount}}' "$n")" = "$count" || exit 73
docker logs --tail 700 "$n" 2>&1 | grep -q '^CREATOR_DM_POLL_READY=PASS$' || exit 74
state="$(docker exec "$pg" psql -U "$user" -d videobot -Atc "SELECT status||':'||handled FROM videobot_webhook_updates WHERE update_id=2956732")"
test "$state" = 'completed:true' || { echo NAV_UPDATE_NOT_COMPLETED; exit 75; }
cursor="$(docker exec "$pg" psql -U "$user" -d videobot -Atc "SELECT last_update_id FROM videobot_poll_cursor WHERE consumer_id='createvdobot'")"
test "$cursor" -ge 2956732 || exit 76
echo LIVE_DM_POLL_STABLE=PASS
echo BLOCKED_START_RECONCILED=PASS
echo LIVE_MENU_REPLAY_PATCH=PASS
